evidence_cards.content: A JU without R² for a nonreal-time track with the TQ field set to value 0 shall assume R² for that track when the track is locally updated by a new nonreal-time report.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This specifies an alternative timing mode (nonreal-time) under which the JU assumes R² upon local update, diverging from real-time track handling in the main flow.

evidence_cards.content: A JU receiving a J2 PPLI message (with the NPS Indicator set to Inactive, Conditional Radio Silence, or TDS Failure) from a JU that has R² of a locally held track, may assume R² at the next opportunity to transmit the track if local reporting eligibility remains and a remote report has not been received on that track.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This outlines an alternative flow triggered by specific PPLI status indicators, allowing the JU to assume R² when remote reporting is compromised.

evidence_cards.content: A JU receiving a J7.0 message with the Track Management Action field set to value 0 (Drop Track Report) on a locally held track shall assume R² at the next opportunity to transmit if local reporting eligibility remains and a remote report has not been received.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines an alternative flow where a JU assumes responsibility (R²) for a track after receiving a Drop Track Report, diverging from the main flow of passive monitoring or relinquishment.

evidence_cards.content: A JU without R² for a nonreal-time track (TQ field set to value 0) shall assume R² for that track when the track is locally updated by a new nonreal-time report.

evidence_cards.content: A unit assuming R² for a ballistic missile track need not assume R² for the associated launch point; the unit no longer holding R² may continue to report the launch point in accordance with transmit/receive rules.

evidence_cards.content: When a JU drops or ceases reporting EW information that it has been reporting on the interface, it shall transmit a J7.0 (ACT = 0) message; however, this message shall not be transmitted on remote reports, and remote reports may be automatically purged based on system criteria.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This describes an alternative flow for terminating EW surveillance data transmission — specifically when a JU stops reporting — which diverges from the main flow of continuous monitoring and receipt of track data. It specifies conditions under which termination occurs and how the system handles cessation without requiring active intervention by the Non-C2 JU.

evidence_cards.content: Non-C2 JUs shall not transmit on the Surveillance NPG.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This is a hard constraint that prevents the Non-C2 JU from initiating transmission or responding via transmission if an error condition (e.g., needing to report a track) occurs; it defines a terminal state for any flow requiring outbound communication on this network.

evidence_cards.content: If a C2 JU has R² for a track and receives a J2 PPLI message from another C2 JU with the same Track Number (TN), it shall accept the PPLI information into its surveillance database and disregard the J3 surveillance data on that track.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines an exception to standard correlation rules where a specific condition (same TN) triggers a forced acceptance of PPLI data over existing J3 data, altering the normal processing flow.

evidence_cards.content: The acceptance of PPLI information when the TN is the same is conditional: if the Geodetic Position Quality in the PPLI message is set to value 0, the surveillance track is accepted and the PPLI message is discarded instead.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies a nested exception condition within the 'same TN' scenario that reverses the data acceptance priority based on quality indicators.

evidence_cards.content: Subsurface tracks are explicitly excluded from correlation with IUs.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Identifies a category of data (subsurface tracks) that must be handled via an exception path (no correlation) rather than the standard integration logic.

evidence_cards.content: If a correlation is not found, the C2 JU shall integrate the received J2 PPLI report into its surveillance database as part of the surveillance picture.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the system response (integration) to an exception condition (no correlation found) during data processing.

evidence_cards.content: If J2 messages are not received subsequent to integration and the receiving C2 JU still has no local data, the C2 JU assumes no responsibility for reporting the subject JU on the Surveillance Network PG.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes a specific failure state or exception outcome where the system ceases reporting due to lack of subsequent data confirmation.

evidence_cards.content: If the position or other data in a PPLI meet a system's decorrelation criteria, the PPLI and local track data shall be decorrelated.

evidence_cards.content: After decorrelation, the C2 JU shall initiate a surveillance track report with locally held data using a new track number.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies the recovery action (new track report) following the decorrelation exception.

evidence_cards.content: The PPLI Track Number and Identity Indicator field and the PPLI IFF/SIF Indicator field shall both be reported as No Statement after decorrelation.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Details specific data constraints applied to the report generated during the exception flow.

evidence_cards.content: A JU shall not report a TQ value which has an associated positional accuracy which is better than that associated with own unit's current geodetic position quality.

evidence_cards.content: A JU shall not artificially increase TQ between sensor inputs.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines a prohibition against manipulating TQ values during sensor input processing, representing a validation or integrity check failure path.

evidence_cards.content: If a C2 JU capable of assuming R² returns to Active status (from Inactive or TDS Failure), it shall not transmit air, surface, or land tracks until sufficient reporting responsibility checks, correlation, and data registration are performed.

evidence_cards.content: The minimum wait before reporting air and surface tracks is 12 seconds, and for land tracks is 48 seconds, following a return to Active status.

evidence_cards.content: Under the condition of irregular reporting of nonreal-time tracks, a J7.0 (ACT = 0) message shall not be transmitted.

evidence_cards.content: In the event of conflict between locally derived information and information reported on the interface regarding ballistic missile tracks, the C² JU shall resolve the difference by transmitting the appropriate J7 message, by operator procedure, or by voice coordination.

evidence_cards.content: Subsurface tracks shall not be correlated with IUs.

evidence_cards.content: If J2 messages are not received subsequent to this action and the receiving C² JU still has no local data, the C² JU assumes no responsibility for reporting the subject JU on the Surveillance Network PG.

evidence_cards.content: The PPLI Track Number and Identity Indicator field and the PPLI IFF/SIF Indicator field shall both be reported as No Statement.

evidence_cards.content: Under the condition of purging tracks after a specific time interval (specifically considering irregular reporting of nonreal-time tracks), a J7.0 (ACT = 0) message shall not be transmitted.

evidence_cards.content: System design should allow for an override in cases where operational necessity requires a shorter wait time or none at all regarding the minimum wait before transmitting tracks.

evidence_cards.content: A C² JU assuming R² of an IU reports it as a track or point on the Surveillance Network PG. The Identity shall be reported as Friend. evidence_cards.content: C² JUs that have the capability to automatically initiate tracks for release to the interface without operator action shall also have the capability to deactivate this automatic capability.

evidence_cards.content: Nonreal-time data shall be identified as such and time tags shall be provided. Nonreal-time track positions shall not be extrapolated.

evidence_cards.content: JUs may apply one exception to the restriction in paragraphs 4.4.4.3.1g(1) and 4.4.4.3.1g(7)(a) above: If either subject track is the Target TN in a J10.2 Engagement Status message originated by the unit attempting correlation, and that track has an ID of Unknown or Hostile, and the other subject track has an ID of Friend, then automatic correlation may be allowed.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the primary condition under which an exception to correlation restrictions is permitted — specifically when conflicting IDs (Unknown/Hostile vs Friend) are present and one track is engaged via J10.2.

evidence_cards.content: The Unknown/Hostile track shall be the dropped Track Number (TN-2). This exception allows breaking the engagement and/or destroying missile(s) in flight.

evidence_cards.content: This exception shall not be applied by any JU upon receipt of a J7.2 Correlation message. evidence_cards.content: C² JUs shall not automatically correlate two tracks if local/remote data held indicates any of the following conditions exist: (1) Identity (ID) difference constituting a conflict; (2) different Mode II codes with local Mode II code current; (3) both tracks are locally derived real-time tracks being updated with local positional data; (4) either track has Strength field set to value greater than 1 — unless systems have an initialization parameter and operator selectable capability to inhibit these restrictions.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines post-use-case system state constraints on automatic correlation behavior after receiving situational awareness data — directly affects whether received tracks will be merged or maintained separately in the Non-C2 JU’s database, which is part of the terminal state after successful receipt.

evidence_cards.content: Systems shall have an initialization parameter and an operator selectable capability to inhibit automatic correlation restrictions for ID conflicts and Mode II mismatches, subject to interface coordination and promulgation to all C² IUs; if use changes, all participating C² IUs must be informed via voice or other communications media; in lieu of specific direction, all IUs restrict automatic correlation by default.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies configurable postconditions affecting system behavior after successful data receipt — determines whether correlation occurs automatically or requires manual intervention, thus shaping the final state of the track database.

evidence_cards.content: When the remote report being tested for correlation is a J2.0 Indirect PPLI message with Originator E/C field set to value 0 (Surface) or 3 (Air), it shall be processed for correlation like a J3.2 air or J3.3 surface (maritime) track with TQ = 7.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines how certain received messages (J2.0 PPLI) are treated post-receipt — they are mapped to equivalent J3.x track types with fixed TQ=7, which influences their correlation eligibility and thus the resulting system state after processing.

evidence_cards.content: A JU relinquishes R² for a real-time Air, Surface (Maritime) or Land (Ground) track upon reception of a remote track report in which remote TQ is greater than the local TQ, or upon reception of a remote track report for the track which contains a TQ equal to the local TQ from a JU whose STN is greater than the local STN.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the specific system state change (relinquishment of R² responsibility) that occurs as a result of receiving superior situational awareness data, constituting a postcondition of the use case.

evidence_cards.content: A JU with R² on a track retains the responsibility until it is relinquished in accordance with the above rules or until the track is dropped.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Establishes the persistence of the R² status as a postcondition, indicating that the system state remains unchanged unless specific termination conditions are met.

evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This indicates that postconditions or success criteria for receiving subsurface track data are defined immediately after this point, but the actual observable outcomes are not present on this page.

evidence_cards.content: Remote surveillance track and point data available in the J3 series messages shall provide nonC² JUs situational awareness and early warning information.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This explicitly states the observable outcome after successful receipt of situational awareness data by a Non-C2 JU: it gains situational awareness and early warning information — which constitutes the terminal system state post-use-case completion.

evidence_cards.content: After successful correlation and integration of PPLI reports with surveillance data, the system state includes: (1) duplicative information is not being transmitted on the Surveillance Network PG; (2) for tracks where the C² JU has R² and correlation is found, the J7.2 Correlation message is transmitted with RV=1, Source TN as Retained TN, and surveillance TN as Dropped TN, followed by cessation of track reporting and transmission of a J7.0 Drop Track message; (3) for tracks where another C² JU has R² and TNs differ, the J7.2 (RV=1) message is transmitted with same TN mapping; (4) for tracks where another C² JU has R² and TNs are same, the JU accepts PPLI into its database and disregards J3 surveillance data unless Geodetic Position Quality in PPLI is 0, in which case surveillance track is accepted and PPLI discarded; (5) subsurface tracks are not correlated with IUs.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: These are explicit postconditions describing the terminal system state after successful completion of integrating PPLI reports with surveillance data — including database updates, message transmissions, track relinquishments, and correlation exclusions — directly defining observable outcomes following use case execution.

evidence_cards.content: After successful correlation, the Non-C2 JU integrates remote track data into its local database by comparing locally derived sensor data (position, velocity, altitude) with received interface data to prevent or eliminate dual designations.

evidence_cards.content: All C² JUs that originate real-time air or surface tracks shall have an automatic correlation capability, ensuring that upon receipt of such tracks, the Non-C2 JU can automatically correlate them with local data as part of post-receipt processing.

evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the terminal state for R² status after successful receipt and processing of situational awareness data — retention persists unless explicitly relinquished per defined conditions or track drop.

evidence_cards.content: A JU relinquishes R² for a real-time Air, Surface (Maritime) or Land (Ground) track upon reception of a remote track report in which remote TQ is greater than the local TQ, or upon reception of a remote track report for the track which contains a TQ equal to the local TQ from a JU whose STN is greater than the local STN.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies explicit postcondition outcomes following successful receipt of remote track reports: R² is relinquished under defined TQ/STN comparison criteria, establishing observable system state changes after use case completion.
